target_cwe.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
target_cwe.description: The product calls a function, procedure, or routine, but the caller specifies too many arguments, or too few arguments, which may lead to undefined behavior and resultant weaknesses.
remediation_steps: Follow secure coding practices and security guidelines
